title: EntityVisualScreen
responsibility: Shows page, shell or component screenshots and keeps component recordings in their own Audio tab.

inputs.name: EntityVisualScreen.index
inputs.description: The HarnessIndex value is carried on host, which this component passes to EntityFrame and EntitySections. This file does not inspect the index or impose additional limits on it.

inputs.name: EntityVisualScreen.head
inputs.description: The HarnessRevision value is carried on host, which this component passes to EntityFrame and EntitySections. This file does not inspect the revision fields directly.

inputs.name: EntityVisualScreen.parent
inputs.description: The nullable HarnessRevision value is carried on host and passed through with the rest of host to EntityFrame and EntitySections. This file does not read or alter parent directly.

inputs.name: EntityVisualScreen.scope
inputs.description: When the entity category is not components, this value is passed unchanged to EntityScreens. It is also carried on host to EntityFrame and EntitySections.

inputs.name: EntityVisualScreen.route
inputs.description: The ExplorerLocation value is carried on host to EntityFrame and EntitySections. This file does not read route directly or invoke navigation from it.

inputs.name: EntityVisualScreen.entities
inputs.description: The ExplorerEntity list is carried on host to EntityFrame and EntitySections. This file does not traverse host.entities directly; its pane uses the entity supplied to the children snippet.

inputs.name: EntityVisualScreen.lens
inputs.description: For each pane render, this component calls host.lens.evidence(entity.unit) and passes the result to the visual and audio children when they render. The result’s scenarios are supplied to screenOptions; this file adds no fallback or local transformation.

inputs.name: EntityVisualScreen.client
inputs.description: The revision-reader value is carried on host, which this component passes to EntityFrame and EntitySections. This file does not call client.revision directly.

inputs.name: EntityVisualScreen.mediaBase
inputs.description: When the entity category is not components, this string is passed unchanged to EntityScreens and EntityAudio. This file does not construct or normalize the base value.

inputs.name: EntityVisualScreen.onroute
inputs.description: The navigation callback is carried on host to EntityFrame and EntitySections. This file does not invoke onroute directly.

outputs.name: EntityVisualScreen.screenshotOverview
outputs.description: The markup renders an hx-div with data-harness-component="harness-entity-visual-screen" and display: contents around EntityFrame and EntitySections. In the pane, EntityScreens and EntityAudio render only when entity.category is not components; EntityScreens receives entity.unit.preview and evidence.scenarios through screenOptions.
